# Ezekiel 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "And-you, son-of-man, prophesy to the-mountains-of Israel and-say: Mountains-of Israel, hear the-word-of YHWH!

**2** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because the-enemy said concerning-you, 'Aha!' and, 'The-ancient high-places have-become a-possession for-us!'"

**3** Therefore prophesy and-say: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because — yes-because — they-made-you-desolate and-swallowed-you from-every-side, so-that-you-became a-possession for-the-rest-of the-nations and-you-were-taken-up on-the-lip-of talkers and-the-evil-report-of [the]-people —

**4** Therefore, mountains-of Israel, hear the-word-of the-Lord YHWH: Thus says the-Lord YHWH to-the-mountains and-to-the-hills, to-the-ravines and-to-the-valleys, to-the-desolate wastes and-to-the-cities-that-are-forsaken, which became a-prey and-a-mockery to-the-rest-of the-nations all-around —

**5** Therefore, thus says the-Lord YHWH: Surely in-the-fire-of My-jealousy I-have-spoken against the-rest-of the-nations and-against all Edom, who gave My-land to-themselves as-a-possession with-whole-hearted joy and-with-contempt-of soul, in-order-to drive-it-out as-a-prey."

**6** Therefore, prophesy concerning the-land-of Israel and-say to-the-mountains and-to-the-hills, to-the-ravines and-to-the-valleys: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Behold, in-My-jealousy and-in-My-wrath I-have-spoken, because the-reproach-of the-nations you-have-borne."

**7** Therefore, thus says the-Lord YHWH: "I have-lifted-up My-hand [in oath]: Surely the-nations which [are] all-around-you — they will-bear their-reproach.

**8** But-you, mountains-of Israel, your-branches you-will-put-forth and-your-fruit you-will-bear for-My-people Israel, for they-are-near to-come.

**9** For behold-Me toward-you, and-I-will-turn to-you, and-you-will-be-tilled and-sown.

**10** And-I-will-multiply upon-you humankind — the-whole house-of Israel, all-of-it — and-the-cities will-be-inhabited and-the-ruins will-be-rebuilt.

**11** And-I-will-multiply upon-you human and-beast, and-they-will-increase and-be-fruitful; and-I-will-cause-you-to-be-inhabited as-in-your-former-times and-do-good more-than your-beginnings; and-you-will-know that I [am] YHWH.

**12** And-I-will-cause-to-walk upon-you people — My-people Israel — and-they-will-possess-you, and-you-will-be to-them an-inheritance, and-you-will-not-again bereave-them."

**13** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Because they-say to-you, 'Devourer-of-humans you-[are], and-bereaver-of your-nation you-have-been,'

**14** Therefore, humans you-will-not-devour anymore, and-your-nation you-will-not-bereave anymore," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**15** "And-I-will-not-cause to-be-heard against-you the-reproach-of the-nations anymore, and-the-disgrace-of the-peoples you-will-not-bear anymore, and-your-nation you-will-not-cause-to-stumble anymore," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**16** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**17** "Son-of-man, the-house-of Israel, while-dwelling on their-own-land, defiled-it by-their-way and-by-their-deeds; like-the-uncleanness-of [a-woman's]-menstruation was their-way before-Me.

**18** And-I-poured-out My-wrath upon-them for the-blood which they-poured-out upon the-land and-[because]-with-their-idols they-defiled-it.

**19** And-I-scattered-them among the-nations, and-they-were-dispersed through the-lands; according-to-their-way and-according-to-their-deeds I-judged-them.

**20** And-they-came to the-nations where they went, and-they-profaned My-holy-name, when-it-was-said of-them, 'The-people-of YHWH these [are], yet-from-His-land they-went-out.'

**21** And-I-had-concern for My-holy-name, which the-house-of Israel had-profaned among-the-nations where they went.

**22** Therefore, say to-the-house-of Israel: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Not for-your-sake [am] I acting, house-of Israel, but for My-holy-name which you-profaned among-the-nations where you went.

**23** And-I-will-sanctify My-great-name which-was-profaned among the-nations, which you-profaned in-their-midst; and-the-nations will-know that I [am] YHWH," declares the-Lord YHWH, "when-I-am-sanctified through-you before-their-eyes.

**24** And-I-will-take-you from-the-nations and-gather-you from-all the-lands and-bring-you to your-own-land.

**25** And-I-will-sprinkle upon-you clean water and-you-will-be-clean; from-all your-uncleannesses and-from-all your-idols I-will-cleanse-you.

**26** And-I-will-give to-you a-new heart, and-a-new spirit I-will-put within-you; and-I-will-remove the-heart-of stone from-your-flesh and-give to-you a-heart-of flesh.

**27** And My-Spirit I-will-put within-you and-cause-you to-walk in-My-statutes, and My-judgments you-will-keep and-do.

**28** And-you-will-dwell in the-land which I-gave to-your-fathers, and-you-will-be to-Me a-people, and-I will-be to-you God.

**29** And-I-will-save-you from-all your-uncleannesses, and-I-will-call to-the-grain and-multiply-it and-not-bring famine upon-you.

**30** And-I-will-multiply the-fruit-of the-tree and-the-produce-of the-field, so-that you-will-not-receive anymore the-reproach-of famine among-the-nations.

**31** And-you-will-remember your-evil-ways and-your-deeds which [were] not-good, and-you-will-loathe-yourselves in-your-own-eyes for your-iniquities and-for your-abominations.

**32** Not for-your-sake [am] I acting," declares the-Lord YHWH, "let-it-be-known to-you. Be-ashamed and-confounded for-your-ways, house-of Israel!"

**33** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "On-the-day I-cleanse-you from-all your-iniquities, I-will-cause the-cities to-be-inhabited and-the-ruins will-be-rebuilt.

**34** And-the-desolate-land will-be-tilled, instead-of being-a-desolation before-the-eyes-of everyone passing-by.

**35** And-they-will-say, 'This land — the-desolate-one — has-become like-the-garden-of Eden; and-the-waste and-desolate and-ruined cities [are now] fortified [and]-inhabited.'

**36** And-the-nations which remain around-you will-know that I, YHWH, have-rebuilt the-ruined and-planted the-desolate. I, YHWH, have-spoken and-I-will-do-[it]."

**37** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Yet for-this I-will-let-Myself-be-sought by-the-house-of Israel to-do-[it] for-them: I-will-multiply-them — the-people — like-a-flock.

**38** Like-the-flock-of holy-offerings, like-the-flock-of Jerusalem at-her-appointed-feasts, so will-the-waste cities be-full-of flocks-of people; and-they-will-know that I [am] YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **36:25**: Ve-zaraqti aleikhem mayim tehorim — 'And I will sprinkle upon you clean waters.' This echoes priestly purification ritual (Numbers 19), now applied to the entire nation.

- **36:26**: Lev hadash ve-ruach hadashah — 'A new heart and a new spirit.' The 'heart of stone' (lev ha-even) replaced by 'heart of flesh' (lev basar) is a radical transformation of human nature, not mere behavioral change.

- **36:27**: Ve-et-ruchi etten be-qirbekhem — 'And My Spirit I will put within you.' This is the most intimate form of divine indwelling in the Hebrew Bible, anticipating the New Covenant theology of Jeremiah 31:31-34.

— EMET
